record.question: Angela Merkel, German Chancellor belongs to
record.explanation: Answer B: Christian Democratic Union. Angela Merkel belonged to the Christian Democratic Union (CDU). The German government's historical biography records her membership from 1990 and party leadership from 2000 to 2018. Historical/source note: Historical June 2014 chancellor; not a claim about the current German chancellor. Reference: https://www.bundeskanzler.de/bk-de/content/angela-merkel-1839844.
